description: This PHP file initializes and controls the Calendar module within the SuiteCRM application. It manages access control, loads configuration and language settings, initializes Calendar objects, handles shared views, and renders the calendar display with various views including print options.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Core class responsible for managing the calendar data and views in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: CalendarDisplay
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the HTML output for the calendar interface.

methods.name: init_shared
methods.description: Initializes shared calendar views and loads shared users' activities.

methods.name: add_activities
methods.description: Adds activities to the Calendar object for the current or shared users.

methods.name: load_activities
methods.description: Loads the activities into the Calendar object for display.

methods.name: display_title
methods.description: Displays the title of the calendar.

methods.name: display_shared_html
methods.description: Displays HTML for shared calendar views.

methods.name: display_calendar_header
methods.description: Displays the header part of the calendar.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the main calendar HTML content.

methods.name: display_calendar_footer
methods.description: Displays the footer of the calendar.
